responsibility: Implements the LRA spill-to-memory (and target-specific spill-to-other-hard-reg) phase plus the final hard-register substitution cleanup. It assigns stack slots to spilled pseudos based on live-range interference and size/alignment, rewrites RTL uses of spilled pseudos to stack memory or alternate spill registers, and at the end converts surviving pseudos to their assigned hard registers while removing temporary clobbers, markers, and useless self-moves. This file is the stage that materializes spill decisions into final RTL locations.
